sloka: यस्मात् भाग अर्थिनो भागान् न अकल्पयत मे सुराः ।वर अंगानि महाअर्हाणि धनुषा शातयामि वः ॥१-६६-१०॥
transliteration: yasmāt bhāga arthino bhāgān na akalpayata me surāḥ ।vara aṁgāni mahāarhāṇi dhanuṣā śātayāmi vaḥ ॥1-66-10॥

translations.english: 'O gods in your anxiety to partake your share of the sacrifie, you have failed to provide mine in the sacrificial offerings. Therefore, I shall sever your jewelled heads and beautiful limbs with this bow'.
translations.hindi: हे पुत्रो ! यह ऋचीक मुनि का पुत्र है। अभी बच्चा है और हमारे शरण में आया है । इसके प्राणां की रक्षा कर हमारा प्रिय कार्य करो
